title: L-EVAL: INSTITUTING STANDARDIZED EVALUATION FOR LONG CONTEXT LANGUAGE MODELS

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the correlation of automatic metrics (n-gram matching and LLM judges) with human judgments to identify a systematic preference for longer generated responses, and proposing Length-Instruction-Enhanced (LIE) evaluation to mitigate this bias.
Swapping the order of paired model predictions during LLM-as-a-judge pairwise evaluations to neutralize the evaluator model's preference for options based purely on their presentation order.
